requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-1486-4231-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2438-2577-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2438-2577-7084-8345.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1829-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

413-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
413-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 5.
413-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1531-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1531-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-3897.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3534-3897.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-3897.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1545-1981-2415-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1545-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

533-5429-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-5429-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Embermaw Hellion.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4785-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

465-670-1619-6140.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6140.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Cloister Gargoyle from exile to the battlefield.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

140-4499-7494.notablePrerequisites: You've lost at least 1 life this turn.
140-4499-7494.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping them, reducing the cost of black and red spells you cast this turn by at least {1}.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
140-4499-7494.notes: You must have lost at least 2 life this turn for this combo to add infinite mana.

232-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
232-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1744-3609-6807.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Vedalken Infuser.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, each Vedalken Infuser triggers, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter and three charge counters on any artifact(s).
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

2092-2544-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2092-2544-6788.description:
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2092-2544-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-3455--39.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Many Faces is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-3455--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Vizier of Many Faces trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

512-3576-4694.notablePrerequisites: Vedalken Engineer and Halo Fountain do not have summoning sickness.
512-3576-4694.description:
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding {W}{W} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping Halo Fountain and Vedalken Engineer, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

282-3724-3975-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-3724-3975-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Aethertorch Renegade that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
The Aethertorch Renegade token(s) enters the battlefield, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the second Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of any creature you control that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

2773-3496-4625.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing Dread Slaver to deal three damage to itself and die due to its deathtouch ability.
Dread Slaver dies, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1656-1835-3995.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-1835-3995.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Zaxara's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

1308-2316-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1308-2316-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
